blurb: `expect <call> faults` claims that a handler throws. At `system` a fault reaches the case as an error response from the deployed Worker, not a throw, so claim it at `unit` or `integration`, or assert the response. A claim driven `by Nobody`, `Forged` or `Stale` fails at every tier: only a `system` case reaches the auth seam that refuses the request. Assert `Rejected(Unauthorized)` in a `system` case instead.
summary: A `system`-tier case claims a fault with `expect <call> faults`, or a fault claim at any tier is driven `by Nobody`, `by Forged`, `by Stale`, `by Expired`, `by WrongIssuer`, `by WrongAudience`, `by WrongAlgorithm` or `by NoSubject`; at `system` a fault reaches the case as an error response from the deployed Worker, never a throw, so the claim belongs at `unit` or `integration`.
